Old tail: EOR#(2) SEC(2) ADC#(2) STA zp(3) LDA abs,X LDA/ORA abs,X TAY LDA zp(3); new drops SEC, ADC #8 and LDA sky_skip (7 cycles, 5 bytes) and adds DEC A (2 cycles, 1 byte): 5 cycles saved every call, 4 bytes saved, given back as SKIP 4 after the RTS so sky_draw stays at &30A3 and nothing after moves (listing: sky_row &3083-&30A2). No self-modified operand in sky_row; the SKIP bytes are after an RTS and never executed. Branch ranges unaffected (no branches in sky_row, nothing after moves).
